import pandas as pd,numpy as np,cv2
d=pd.read_csv('out/demo_metadata.csv'); o=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv')
print(list(d.columns)==list(o.columns), len(d)==len(o), (d.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y','type'])==o.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y','type'])).all().all())
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); H,W=img.shape[:2]
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int); vis=img.copy(); bad=0
for i,r in d.iterrows():
  xs=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))));ys=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(','))))
  m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],1); cnt+=m
  n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m,connectivity=4)
  area=m.sum(); bb=(xs.max()-xs.min()+1)*(ys.max()-ys.min()+1)
  if n!=2 or area/bb>0.95: bad+=1; print('bad',i,n,area/bb)
  assert (xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max())==(r.xmin,r.xmax,r.ymin,r.ymax)
  cv2.polylines(vis,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],True,(0,255,0),1)
  ox=np.array(list(map(int,o.coords_x[i].split(','))));oy=np.array(list(map(int,o.coords_y[i].split(','))))
  cv2.polylines(img,[np.stack([ox,oy],1)],True,(0,0,255),1)
print('max overlap',cnt.max(),'bad',bad)
try:
  from shapely.geometry import Polygon
  P=[Polygon(zip(map(int,r.coords_x.split(',')),map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))) for _,r in d.iterrows()]
  print('valid',sum(p.is_valid for p in P), 'overlaps',sum(P[i].intersection(P[j]).area>0 for i in range(len(P)) for j in range(i+1,len(P))))
except ImportError: print('no shapely')
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',np.concatenate([cv2.resize(img,None,fx=2,fy=2),cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2)],1))
"
